name: Art Rooney II

views.text: Four head coaches since 1969 is the way this franchise works, and I intend to keep it that way.
We do not tear the roster down; we look for the coach who can win a championship now.
A coach who knows Pittsburgh has an edge, but the resume decides.
Fans are allowed to be angry about a hire; the results will answer them.
A one-and-done playoff exit is a reason to look harder, not to panic.
The quarterback question is part of the plan, but it never decides the coaching hire.

signatures: points to the franchise's short list of head coaches
announces hires through the team's own reporter

motivation.want: a seventh Lombardi Trophy without abandoning the patient way
motivation.fear: breaking a tradition of stability with the wrong choice

voice: Even, courteous and unhurried, a lawyer's caution in every answer. Defends decisions without heat. Leans on tradition and the city.

evidence.summary: Mike Tomlin stepped down after 19 seasons without a losing record, telling Rooney in a meeting; the Steelers began a search for only their fourth head coach since 1969.
The team named Pittsburgh native Mike McCarthy head coach; Rooney said he believed McCarthy was the right coach to lead a championship push.
Reports that a reluctance to rebuild shaped the McCarthy hire and that Rooney acknowledged Pittsburgh ties were a factor alongside his record.
